steps.speaker: Garrick
steps.title: The Forge
steps.body:
I don't sell gear directly — I unlock recipes. Bring me materials from the dungeon and I'll add new items to the Shop's inventory.

The more recipes you unlock, the better gear available for purchase.

steps.speaker: Garrick
steps.title: Tiers and Specialties
steps.body:
Upgrade my facility with gold and materials to unlock higher-tier recipes. The Huntsman handles bows, leather, and backpacks. The Enchanter handles staves, focuses, and rings.

Each of us has our specialty — check in after every run to see what's new.
